tool.name: selscan
tool.description: EHH-based haplotype scans for positive selection (EHH, iHS, XP-EHH, nSL, XP-nSL, iHH12, pi)
tool.command:
#set $outname = 'selscan.' + $statistic + '.out' #if $statistic == 'ehh' #set $outname = 'selscan.ehh.' + str($locus_id) + '.out' #elif $statistic == 'pi' #set $outname = 'selscan.pi.' + str($pi_win) + '.out' #end if #if $alt #set $outname = $outname.replace('.out', '.alt.out') #end if
selscan #if $statistic == 'ihs' --ihs #elif $statistic == 'xpehh' --xpehh #elif $statistic == 'nsl' --nsl #elif $statistic == 'xpnsl' --xpnsl #elif $statistic == 'ihh12' --ihh12 #elif $statistic == 'ehh' --ehh '$locus_id' #elif $statistic == 'pi' --pi --pi-win $pi_win #end if --vcf '$in_file' #if ($statistic == 'xpehh' or $statistic == 'xpnsl') and $ref_file --vcf-ref '$ref_file' #end if #if $map_file --map '$map_file' #end if --maf $maf --cutoff $cutoff --max-extend $max_extend --max-extend-nsl $max_extend_nsl --ehh-win $ehh_win --gap-scale $gap_scale --max-gap $max_gap $keep_low_freq $trunc_ok $pmap $unphased $wagh $alt $ihs_detail --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} --out selscan && mv '$outname' '$out_file'

param.name: statistic
param.label: Statistic to calculate
param.option: nSL (number of segregating sites by length)

param.name: in_file
param.label: Phased haplotype data (VCF)
param.help: Haplotype data coded 0/1. No missing genotypes are allowed. For iHS, XP-EHH, EHH and iHH12 a genetic map is required.

param.name: ref_file
param.label: Reference population VCF (XP-EHH / XP-nSL)
param.help: Reference population haplotype data for cross-population statistics. Must contain the same loci as the query file.

param.name: map_file
param.label: Genetic map file
param.help: Tab-delimited file with one row per variant: <chr#> <locusID> <genetic position> <physical position>. Required for iHS, XP-EHH, EHH and iHH12 when using VCF input.

param.name: locus_id
param.label: Locus ID for EHH calculation
param.help: The locus ID (from the map file) at which to calculate EHH. Only used when the EHH statistic is selected.

param.name: maf
param.label: Minimum minor allele frequency (MAF)
param.help: Minimum MAF for a variant to be used as a core SNP.

param.name: max_extend
param.label: Maximum EHH extension (bp)
param.help: Maximum distance in bp to extend the EHH decay calculation from the core. A value <= 0 means no restriction.

param.name: max_extend_nsl
param.label: Maximum nSL extension (SNPs)
param.help: Maximum number of SNPs to extend the nSL haplotype. A value <= 0 means no restriction.

param.name: ehh_win
param.label: EHH window (bp)
param.help: EHH window size in bp in each direction.

param.name: gap_scale
param.label: Gap scaling (bp)
param.help: Gap scaling in bp. If a gap is larger than this value but smaller than the maximum gap, genetic distance is scaled by GAP_SCALE/GAP.

param.name: max_gap
param.label: Maximum gap (bp)
param.help: Maximum gap in bp between SNPs.

param.name: pi_win
param.label: pi window (bp)
param.help: Sliding window size in bp for the pi statistic.

param.name: keep_low_freq
param.label: Keep low-frequency variants
param.help: Include low-frequency variants in haplotypes (by default low-frequency variants are skipped).

param.name: trunc_ok
param.label: Allow truncated EHH curves
param.help: Integrate the EHH curve even if decay reaches the sequence end before the cutoff (iHS/XP-EHH only).

param.name: pmap
param.label: Use physical map
param.help: Use the physical map instead of the genetic map.

param.name: unphased
param.label: Use unphased multilocus genotypes
param.help: Use unphased multilocus genotypes instead of phased haplotypes. Not compatible with iHH12 or pi.

param.name: wagh
param.label: Use Wagh EHH denominator (XP-EHH)
param.help: Use the Wagh EHH denominator for XP-EHH, which separates the core SNP alleles. XP-EHH only; do not use with the alt option.

param.name: alt
param.label: Use sum of squared haplotype frequencies
param.help: Calculate homozygosity using the sum of squared haplotype frequencies instead of binomial coefficients.

param.name: ihs_detail
param.label: Write iHS detail columns
param.help: Write left/right iHH for the derived and ancestral alleles in addition to iHS.

tool.help:
**What it does**
selscan is a multithreaded program that calculates EHH-based haplotype scans for positive selection in genomes. It implements the EHH, iHS, XP-EHH, nSL, XP-nSL and iHH12 statistics, as well as a pairwise nucleotide diversity (pi) sliding-window mode.
selscan is "dumb" with respect to ancestral/derived coding and simply expects haplotype data to be coded 0/1. Unstandardized iHS/nSL scores are thus reported as log(iHH1/iHH0) based on the coding you have provided. It should be run separately for each chromosome and population (or population pair for XP-EHH / XP-nSL).
**Statistics**
- **iHS** (integrated haplotype score) — detects recent or ongoing positive selection using the ratio of integrated EHH for the derived and ancestral alleles. Requires a genetic map. - **nSL** (number of segregating sites by length) — similar to iHS but uses the number of segregating sites rather than genetic distance. Does not require a genetic map. - **XP-EHH** (cross-population EHH) — compares EHH between two populations to detect selective sweeps that have gone to fixation in one population. Requires a reference population and a genetic map. - **XP-nSL** — cross-population version of nSL. Requires a reference population; does not require a genetic map. - **iHH12** — detects hard and soft sweeps using the sum of the two largest haplotype homozygosity classes. Requires a genetic map. - **EHH** — extended haplotype homozygosity at a single locus. Requires a genetic map and a locus ID. - **pi** — mean pairwise nucleotide diversity in sliding windows. Does not require a genetic map.
**Input**
- **VCF** — phased haplotype data coded 0/1 (no missing genotypes allowed). Both plain VCF and bgzipped VCF are accepted. - **Reference VCF** — required for XP-EHH and XP-nSL. Must contain the same loci as the query file. - **Genetic map** — tab-delimited file with one row per variant: `<chr#> <locusID> <genetic position> <physical position>`. Required for iHS, XP-EHH, EHH and iHH12 when using VCF input.
**Output**
The tool produces a tab-delimited score file with a header line and one row per locus (or per window for pi). The columns depend on the selected statistic:
- iHS/nSL: `chr id pos freq ihh1 ihh0 <stat>` - XP-EHH/XP-nSL: `chr id pos gpos p1 ihh1 p2 ihh2 <stat>` - iHH12: `chr id pos freq ihh12` - EHH: `chr pdist gdist derEHH ancEHH EHH` - pi: `start end pi`
The iHS/nSL and XP-EHH/XP-nSL scores are unstandardized. Use the **selscan norm** tool to standardize them (and to generate windowed summaries).
**Attribution**
This Galaxy tool wraps the selscan program (https://github.com/szpiech/selscan), developed by Zachary A. Szpiech.
